chunks: The day when they will come out of their graves in all haste as though rushing to their altars,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how disbelievers will emerge from their graves on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'arij highlights the sudden and chaotic emergence of the disbelievers, contrasting their frantic rush with the orderly ascent of the righteous. The comparison to rushing to 'nusub' (idols or altars) underscores that their haste is not merely physical but spiritual, driven by a lingering attachment to false worship even in the face of divine judgment. This imagery serves as a warning that disbelief leaves the soul in a state of perpetual urgency, unable to find true rest until the final reckoning.
